values.value: Duplicate active flows on same object

Finds: SObjects with 3 or more active record-triggered flows (RecordAfterSave or RecordBeforeSave). Critical at 5+. Why it matters: Multiple flows on one object compound at every save — each runs serially, can re-trigger field updates, and combined runtime contributes to UI latency and spinning-wheel timeouts on edit pages. Order-of-execution interactions get hard to reason about past 3 flows; performance starts to bite past 5. Consolidate where logic overlaps, or document the precise execution order for the rest. Suppress a finding: when the multiple flows are intentionally separated and you've already established a documented order of execution. Disable the detector: only if your org has policy that mandates one-flow-per-concern even when many flows accumulate.
